name: actuary
description: Audit and evaluate Agent Skills against the agentskills.io spec and authoring best practices. First skill: skill-audit (layered L1 spec / L2 structural / L3 craft report).

interface.longDescription: Audit Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) against the agentskills.io specification and authoring best practices. Produces a layered report covering spec compliance, structural metrics, and craft-level recommendations. Read-only — never modifies the audited skills.
defaultPrompt: Audit the skills in this plugin.
Check this SKILL.md against agentskills best practices.
Triage every skill in the toolshed marketplace.
